purpose: Teach: ランナー/協奏曲/イエロー/ベリー/タラ/兎/フェリー/ランニング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、彼、マラソンランナーだったんだって、知ってた、最近?
lines.en: Hey, did you know your boyfriend is a marathon runner? That's pretty recent, right?
lines.style: Warm, curious opening with a slight lift of discovery. Leaning in with genuine interest. Conversational pace, friendly and engaged.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。クラシック、ピアノ協奏曲、よく聴いてるよ、私、最近。
lines.en: Yeah. I've actually been listening to a lot of classical music lately — piano concertos, mostly.
lines.style: Gentle redirect, slightly distant in thought. Voice softer, introspective. A pause before answering, like she's noticing it herself as she speaks.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 新作のドレス、イエロー系、爽やかで、いいよね、葵にも似合う。
lines.en: Oh, and there's this new yellow dress I saw — so fresh and bright. It would look really good on you.
lines.style: Animated enthusiasm bubbling back up. Light, encouraging tone. Quick delivery with genuine warmth behind the compliment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夏のベリーパフェ、店で、メニュー化したよ、人気だよ。
lines.en: Actually, we just added a summer berry parfait to the menu at the café, and it's been really popular.
lines.style: Brightening up, taking her turn to share. Pride in her voice but not boastful. Steady, matter-of-fact delivery with quiet satisfaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: タラ料理、ノルウェー風で、彼の手作り、美味しかったんだ、昨日。
lines.en: He made this Norwegian-style cod dish for me yesterday — it was really delicious.
lines.style: Softer again, reflective and warm. A small smile in the voice. Trailing slightly, savoring the memory. Intimate but not exclusive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 動物カフェで、兎、抱っこできたよ、可愛かった、本当に。
lines.en: I got to hold a rabbit at an animal café the other day. It was so cute.
lines.style: Childlike delight returning. Brighter, more animated. Brief and genuine, like the joy of the moment hasn't faded. Small lilt of happiness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 瀬戸内海のフェリー、彼と乗ろうって、約束してるの。
lines.en: We promised we'd take the ferry across the Seto Inland Sea together sometime.
lines.style: Softer and more wistful. Looking forward and inward at once. Quiet certainty in the promise. Gentle trailing-off, like holding the thought.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 朝のランニング、習慣にしてるよ、私、最近、健康のため。
lines.en: I've been making morning runs part of my routine lately — it's been good for my health.
lines.style: Reflective and grounded. Steady, quiet confidence. Slower pace, like she's taken stock of herself. Closing with gentle resolve, not breathless.
